Greenhouse effect
1) Gases that have the tendency of absorbing infrared radiation emitted from earth’s surface and reradiating it back to earth’s surface, thus contributing to the greenhouse effect. 2) There are several factors that influences the concentration of greenhouse gases. Since industrial revolution, due to the combustion of fossil fuels caused the rise in atmospheric concentration of various greenhouse gases, especically CO 2 , CH 4, O 3 and CFC.
3) Due to rise in green house gases the earth’s temperature is rising which is consequently leading to climate change. They also add to respiratory disease because smog and air pollution caused by green house gases.
